name: Punatitan
sum: Punatitan is a titanosaur from the Cienaga del Rio Huaco Formation of La Rioja, Argentina, found at a site rich in titanosaur eggs.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; from the Quebrada de Santo Domingo site.
biology: Its site holds one of the largest concentrations of titanosaur eggs known.
author: Hechenleitner et al. 2020
